news.summary:
China’s industry minister is set to lead Anhui province, a key semiconductor hub, in the latest personnel reshuffle within the Communist Party.
Li Lecheng, 61, has served as minister of industry and information technology since April 2025.

news.headline: Football: Full squad train under Zidane as tactical changes expected for France
news.summary: After an initial training session with just 12 players, Zinédine Zidane had a full squad at his disposal on Tuesday. The manager could revert to a 4-3-3 formation, with Kylian Mbappé on the left and Ousmane Dembélé as striker.
